title: Claim
description: Interpretive claim record for the Counter-Archive Right Axis. Represents critical operations, hypotheses, and interpretations distinct from documentary Object records. Only claims with review_state='approved' render on public pages.

id.description: Unique identifier for this claim. Should be human-readable and descriptive.

statement.description: The claim text. Must be clear, citable, and non-redundant with Object metadata.

statement_pt.description: Portuguese version of the statement, if different from the primary statement.

review_state.description: Editorial review status. Only 'approved' claims appear on public pages.

about.description: Array of Object IDs this claim is about. Must be non-empty.

deconstructs_iconclass.description: Iconclass deconstruction mapping for the Counter-Archive.

critical_label.description: Human-readable label for the critical operation.

matrix_triad_dimension.description: Which dimension of the hystera → matrix → matriz triad this claim addresses.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting this claim. Required when epistemic_status is 'documented'.

locator.description: Page, figure, or other locator within the source.

note.description: Explanation of how this source supports the claim.

concepts.description: Array of Concept IDs this claim mobilizes.

counter_evidence.description: Evidence that contradicts or complicates this claim.

open_questions.description: Open questions or uncertainties related to this claim.

supersedes.description: ID of a claim this claim supersedes or replaces.

superseded_by.description: IDs of claims that supersede this claim.

strands.description: Strand IDs this claim is associated with.

author_notes.description: Internal author notes not for public display.

updated_at.description: When this claim was last updated.

published_at.description: When this claim was approved for publication.
